LSJZ1-9: Constructed in the 1930s, it is a two-story Western-style villa with three rooms in parallel.
LSJZ1-10: Constructed between 1911 and 1949, it is two-story brick-stone structured villa with slope-roof, the typical villa style at that time.

LSJZ1-17: Constructed between 1911 and 1949, it is a two-story brick-stone building with delicate slope-roofs.
